name: dynamic storage unknown callable arguments retain actual values
source: function invoke(callback: any, value: number[], original: any): void { callback(value, original); } function main(): void { const values: number[] = []; const original: any = {x: 7}; const writer: any = new Function("value", "original", "value[0] = original"); invoke(writer, values, original); console.log(values[0] === original, typeof values[0], values[0].x); }
